Playbook.name: ECC — Mass User/Role/Group Administration by One Operator - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: One operator performed a mass of user/role/group administration actions in the ECC system (ES|QL aggregate, type ECC_USR_AUDIT, excluding 2025 baseline). Triage: bulk legitimate administration, or an operator mass-manipulating access (privilege abuse/compromise)?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Mass access-administration by one operator can rapidly grant fraudulent privileges or create backdoor access at scale.

LogSources.LogSource: ACH/ECC application audit via apps-* - apps-*

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Banking-app audit in apps-* (verified live). ACH maker-checker fields USERNAME_MAKER/USERNAME_CHECKER; ECC user-admin type ECC_USR_AUDIT. type field distinguishes app streams (ACHAPP, ECC_USR_AUDIT).

Signal.Name: Mass User/Role/Group Administration by O
Signal.Details: one operator with mass ECC user/role/group changes.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the mass ECC administration is legitimate bulk work or privilege abuse/compromise.

Step.name: The operator's ECC administration volume and actions
Step.Purpose: The volume and nature of changes separate a legitimate bulk task from mass privilege manipulation.
Step.Query: FROM apps-* | WHERE type == "ECC_USR_AUDIT" AND USERNAME == "$user" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS changes = COUNT(*), actions = VALUES(ACTION_NAME) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: A large number of user/role/group changes in a short window by one operator is the signal. Legitimate bulk onboarding/migration is documented; unannounced mass changes, especially granting privileges, are abuse/compromise.

Node.Condition: Mass privilege-granting changes by one operator with no documented bulk task.
Node.Result: True Positive (Mass Privilege Abuse - escalate, review all changes)

Node.Condition: A documented bulk onboarding/migration by an authorised operator.
A migration/automation using one operator account (baseline gap).

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-ECC-VOLUME to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the task; close as benign_activity.

TruePositive.Definition: Mass privilege manipulation by one operator.

SOCAction.Item: Review ALL the changes; reverse unauthorised grants; disable the operator if compromised; escalate to fraud/compliance; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A migration using one operator account.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Identify the operator and the scope of changes.
If abuse, review all changes and reverse unauthorised grants.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Review all changes; reverse unauthorised grants; disable the operator if compromised; escalate.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Govern bulk access-administration; require change tickets; alert on mass admin actions.

QualityChecks.Check: type ECC_USR_AUDIT; excludes 2025 baseline. Correlate the specific grants in the app.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Unauthorised grants reversed; operator reviewed; fraud/compliance engaged.
